review.body:
**Quinn** (Quality & Release Reviewer) > Independent acceptance: CIX-128 v3 exact five-module qualification PASS.

Reviewed under sole-reviewer claim 9d0797a2-af6b-4728-894b-403a02482490, root admission 70ddc623-40b0-43b0-8b13-95280c3baf5a and terminal 48718aac-e87e-4694-87bd-bbf26dd3049f. Read-only review; no native rerun, product edits or new local files.

Candidate manifest SHA256 7817e61b048693096be8faba39bcda5004152a0d2d37cbcb60d33cec5fa15cc4: all 263 bindings match. Reference manifest 48fcc3a9018a149cd63cc65f03c70f3f2835ba512073d68dd31c48f3ede9e2ec: all 528 bindings match. All nine terminal evidence bindings match. Live and executed test identity is bdfb53ca00ee0a007169b40f9f294b71bbc4829d777929c11d782f76b66ff192; five production modules and canonical fixtures remain bound unchanged.

Focused log records 8/8 Rust tests. Recipe and preserved result establish 28 byte-identical canonical native frames, 56 fresh-process native decodes and 28 Python reference cross-decodes. The 45 grammar variants agree in both decoders: 15 absent-final-LF inputs restore exact input; 30 empty-component/missing-vector inputs reject for the intended parser reason. All 103 subprocess records reconcile: 73 successful commands and 30 expected native rejection exits (101), with rejection reason asserted and no output file. Test-only v2→v3 diff preserves binary/palette truncation, header, trailing-payload, count and expansion checks and adds text-delimiter identity plus required-vector checks. This resolves the previously classified overly strict LF truncation assertion without changing the production grammar.

Recovery archive SHA256 ab97ad96b68ba44f0e2c431b37d291396a3ac6671f5a72f824edadca70f052d6, 6,563,723 bytes: independently streamed all 301 declared members, resolving archive hardlinks and the run/ prefix; every size/hash matches, none missing. No extraction. Frozen raw execution records child/supervisor exit 0, verified core-8/approximately-1GB/no-swap confinement, no stop reason, 4.352s wall and 3.569s CPU. These are execution diagnostics, not performance qualification; sampled memory is not a certified peak.

Copied v2 spec ID/transient-unit label is a disclosed labeling defect, not evidence of executing the old candidate: frozen command, raw/output paths, admission, candidate/test hashes and preserved outputs all identify v3. Accept terminal's explicit correction while preserving original raw/spec and v2 evidence; future specifications should use the correct ID.

Acceptance is limited to this frozen five-module closure and stated tests. RC-55, full product/CLI/SDK qualification, broader compatibility and performance acceptance remain separate. Review complete; sole reviewer lease released now, zero local growth.
